name: zombie
text: "Zombie" is an acquired template that can be added to any corporeal creature (other than an undead).
fly_rule: Bestiary 1 p. 288, Speed: 'Winged zombies can still fly, but maneuverability drops to clumsy. If the base creature flew magically, so can the zombie. Retain all other movement types.'
slam_rule: Bestiary 1 p. 288: 'It also gains a slam attack that deals damage based on the zombie's size, but as if it were one size category larger than its actual size.' One slam: a base that already strikes with slams (the hill giant's '2 slams') keeps the better of its own die and the template's, and does not add a third. Paizo's own application, the zombie hill giant of Rise of the Runelords Anniversary Edition (via d20pfsrd, 'Zombie, Giant (Hill)'), prints 'slam +17 (1d8+13)', one slam.
standing_tags_why: Staggered (Ex): poor reflexes, one move or standard action a round. A trait of the body, never lifted by rest, so a standing tag rather than the condition (whose recovery is recovery.rest).
describe: {A_base} dragged back from death: slow, rotting and relentless, it does not stop.
